summary: Wide street kerb where cars park; homes 12-23 m across a garden.

best_section.where: East kerb mid-block of Tenth Avenue, beside the townhouse row

drivers.seclusion: Townhouses 12-17 m away on the same side; houses all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street; two cars parked on the east side near 45-50 m in the images.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 7.5% at the best section, up to 27% in places
sun_shade: Open to sun; some tree shade from the south end and the east gardens.
